title: 100 modern camera and drone profiles
objective: Support a broad 100-model modern camera/drone selection through data-driven RAW capabilities with authentic evidence.
context_summary: Owner requests Luna subagents and a widely used cross-brand mix; current three-camera path is on main. Pinned backend capabilities, authentic samples and resource bounds constrain mode admission.
